posts.title: A Beginners Guide to FPV Drones
posts.description: This beginner's guide is arguably one of the best because it comes from a beginner. I write as I go. I couldn't explain anything I'm a pro at better, because I've forgotten what's easy and what's hard while my FPV journey is still fresh. I also remember the impatient "just let me fly already" feeling, so I'll keep it short and sweet.

posts.title: I used Fable to rewrite 65kLoC to Rust. It cost $400.
posts.description: I rewrote rune, my 65kLoC Go terminal editor, to Rust with Fable 5 for about $400. The trick is to turn a code problem into a data problem.

posts.title: LLM explains LLM
posts.description: One phrase — "The Eiffel Tower is in" — traced all the way through a language model: tokenizer, vectors, attention, the MLP, sampling, the loop. Then where the weights come from, why the thing can write Python, and how a loop of ordinary code turns it into an agent.
